research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Heroku is focusing on enhancing its platform as a service (PaaS) capabilities, particularly in the areas of automation, security, and container management. The company is developing systems for managing security approvals of services deployed in cloud platforms, which streamline the software development lifecycle. Additionally, Heroku is working on controlled updates of containers in distributed application environments, ensuring efficient and reliable deployment processes. These efforts highlight Heroku's commitment to improving automation and security in cloud-based application development.

about_short_description.short_description: Heroku is a platform as a service (PaaS) that provides services to create, run, and scale web and mobile apps.

product.name: Heroku Platform
product.description: A fully managed platform-as-a-service for deploying, running, managing, and scaling web and mobile applications in cloud-based runtime environments.

product.name: Heroku Postgres
product.description: A fully managed PostgreSQL database service for storing, querying, and scaling relational application data on Heroku.

product.name: Heroku Enterprise
product.description: An enterprise application platform offering isolated runtime environments, identity management, compliance features, centralized oversight, and enterprise support.

product.name: Heroku AI
product.description: A managed platform for building and deploying AI applications and agents, including model access, tool integration, and vector search capabilities.

product.name: Heroku Key-Value Store
product.description: A fully managed Redis-based key-value data service for caching, session storage, queues, and other low-latency application workloads.

product.name: Heroku Elements Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace of add-ons, integrations, buildpacks, and application templates that extend Heroku applications and development workflows.
